name: PdxFieldGroup
description:
Scopes the fields inside it to a nested object of the form, rendered inline, as a collapsible
panel or behind a dialog.

members.name: name
members.description: Group name — maps to a nested object key in the form data.

members.name: label
members.description: Optional label rendered as a fieldset legend.

members.name: display
members.description:
Display mode: inline (default), dialog, panel. A mode renders its own markup, each with its
fixed class, so it is no variant axis; what changes within one, collapsed, is a state.

members.name: collapsed
members.description: Whether a panel is collapsed (display="panel" only).

events.name: collapsed-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `collapsed`. Does not bubble.
